design: Illustrative overhung end-suction pump / jaw coupling / TEFC induction motor
rights: Original MIT geometry; ordinary Manifold3D authoring dependency, no supplier CAD

parts.name: Volute casing
parts.description: Connected spiral collecting passage with eccentric shell and discharge cut; 10 mm minimum wall, illustrative volute approximation, not hydraulic design.

parts.name: Suction nozzle flange
parts.description: 52 mm bore; drilled 4 x 12 mm on 170 mm bolt circle. Field mating flange not supplied.

parts.name: Backward swept impeller vanes

simplifications: Collecting chamber uses a stepped spiral approximation with eccentric shell; no hydraulic performance claim.
Equivalent 12 closed copper bundles, not turn-by-turn electrical winding; slot liner films and phase lead routing unresolved.
Fastener thread helices omitted; shaft and coupling keys representative, no fit class or torque rating.
No manufacturer dimensional, strength, thermal, electrical or pressure verification.
Seals/bearing interference and preload not certified; numerical checks cover stated illustrative clearances only.
